_comment: Baseline snapshot: TaintBench finding IDs ctadl currently detects via a connected source->sink path. Both findings' source (Cursor.getString) and sinks (SQLiteDatabase.insert/update) are recognized as endpoints, but ctadl connects neither: the labelled flows cross Intent IPC, JSON serialize/deserialize, and async network callbacks that the analysis does not track end-to-end. Baseline is therefore empty; if ctadl later connects one, the check reports it as an improvement to fold in here. See ../../README.md.
